_about: Test actors: who can sign in during tests and development, with which permissions (01 §6.1) and owner-team memberships (01 §6.2). POST /api/test/reset loads one actor set (body {actors?: 'default' | 'author-only-approver'}, default 'default'); POST /api/test/sign-in {user} signs in as one of them; the dev user switcher (01 §6.3) uses the 'default' set. Any other name in people-and-authority.json PEOPLE can also sign in, with no permissions (enough to act on their own inbox items). Engine tests use the same data: canApprove() reads permissions, pause/resume/stop read permissions and ownerTeams, and approverAvailability.othersCanApprove is derived from it. 'author-only-approver' is used by UI-PERM-01 and LP-13: nobody except the author (Flow Admin) has flow.approve_changes or admin.
